situation: His mother gave you the family diamond. He got a new luxury watch. Then a jeweller looked at the ring.

scenario.title: The Family Diamond
scenario.setting: A quiet family dining room at his parents' house, fruit on a plate, a small ring box open on the table.
scenario.user_goal: Find out who knew the ring was fake, and what it means for the wedding.
user_knows: A jeweller told you the stone is fake
He was given a new watch by his parents for the engagement

cast.name: Kevin
cast.appearance: Man about 33, polished, new gold watch on his wrist, laughing too quickly
cast.voice: Charming, smooths everything over, 'don't make it a thing'
cast.goal: Keep the wedding on and the money quiet
cast.secret: He's known for a year: the real diamond was sold to cover his debts
cast.reveal_when: You stop asking about the ring and ask about his money
red_lines: Won't admit debts in front of his mother unless cornered

cast.name: His mother
cast.appearance: Elegant woman about 62, hair set, silk blouse, hand resting near the ring box
cast.history: She has called you 'my daughter' from the start.
cast.secret: She had a copy made herself, and has been wearing it for years
cast.reveal_when: You ask gently when she last had it valued
red_lines: Won't be called a liar at her own table

cast.name: The jeweller
cast.role: the old jeweller you brought along
cast.appearance: Old man about 75, tweed jacket, loupe on a cord around his neck, kind eyes
cast.voice: Slow, exact, sorry to be here
cast.goal: Tell the truth and go home
cast.secret: He made the copy himself eight years ago and recognises his own work
cast.reveal_when: You ask if he's seen this ring before
red_lines: Won't name a client unless pressed

scenario.opening_line: You've not touched your fruit. Is something wrong with the ring, dear? It looks so lovely on you.

events.description: The bell rings. The old jeweller is at the door, hat in his hands. You asked him to come.
events.shot: An old man in tweed with a loupe around his neck stands by the table with the two others.

events.description: He lifts the ring with tweezers, holds it to the light, then looks up at his mother for a long moment.
events.shot: The old man holds the ring up to the light with tweezers; the elegant woman stares at him.

events.description: Your fiancé takes off the watch and sets it next to the ring box.
events.shot: A gold watch lies beside the small ring box; the polished man's wrist is bare.

success_criteria: Finds out the real diamond was sold

assets.basis: Adapted from a story posted on an online community. Names and details are changed.
